title: Sitting in with Sharkey and Pinky as a teenager
summary: Before unions, he sat in with anyone, especially Sharkey, at about sixteen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh yeah. I sat in with quite a few bands. Dick, I sat in with Pinky. When Pinky was with the Owls. I used to go around. Well in those days you could sit, nobody was Union, sit in with anybody, you know? I used to always, wherever Sharky played I'd be, when I was a youngster. And, uh, sitting with Sharky, Sharky let me, you know, take down and let me do most of the driving. He used to get a kick out of me because I was about, oh I was only about sixteen years old, just a youngster.
Did you model your playing on anybody in those days in particular?
